The highlight of my visit was undoubtedly the sandwiches. The veg cheese grill was exceptional - the cheese was gooey, and the vegetables were perfectly grilled, making it a satisfying and wholesome meal.

The ambiance of the place was cozy and inviting, and the staff was friendly and attentive. They happily accommodated my preferences and made the experience even better.

I highly recommend visiting the Nature Juice Centre for anyone who appreciates fresh and delicious beverages. Whether you're a juice enthusiast or simply looking for a tasty and healthy treat, this place has something for everyone. I will definitely be returning to try more of their seasonal delights and fruit creams.

1. Fruit Fresh Juice: These are juices made from freshly squeezed fruits, preserving their natural flavors and nutrients. It could include options like orange juice, apple juice, watermelon juice, pineapple juice, etc.

2. Mix Fruit Combo: This would be a combination of various fresh fruits blended together to create a refreshing and flavorful juice. It might include a mix of fruits like bananas, berries, kiwi, mangoes, and more.

3. Fresh Fruit Milkshake: These are milkshakes made with fresh fruits, milk, and sometimes ice cream. They are rich and creamy, offering a delightful treat. Common options could be banana milkshake, strawberry milkshake, or mango milkshake.

4. Vegetable Juice: Juices made from fresh vegetables, providing a nutritious and healthy option. Common vegetable juices include carrot juice, beetroot juice, spinach juice, or a mix of different vegetables.

5. Fruit and Vegetables Combos: These are juices that combine both fresh fruits and vegetables to offer a balanced and nutrient-packed drink. For example, a carrot-apple juice or a spinach-pineapple juice.

6. Milkshake: Apart from fresh fruit milkshakes, they might offer other classic milkshakes like chocolate milkshake, vanilla milkshake, or butterscotch milkshake.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Amar Juice Centre, a place I’d heard quite a bit about—especially for its pav bhaji.

I tried the butter pav bhaji and a mango shake. To be honest, the pav bhaji didn’t quite live up to the hype for me. It was decent, but nothing particularly memorable, and it didn’t really satisfy that nostalgic craving for authentic Mumbai-style pav bhaji that I was hoping for.

The mango shake, however, was the standout. It was fresh, flavorful, and easily the highlight of the visit.

The setup is pretty straightforward—located right on the main road, with a stand-and-eat format. You can also enjoy your food in your parked car, which is quite convenient. The staff was courteous, and the service was impressively quick, which adds to the overall ease of the experience.

Overall, Amar Juice Centre is worth a stop for its juices and quick bites, but if you're going in with high expectations for the pav bhaji, you might find it a bit underwhelming.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Instagrammable Bandra café with average food and high prices 📸

Visited Juco Café around 2 PM for lunch. The café is quite small and a bit cramped with just about four tables, but I have to say — the ambience is super aesthetic, vibrant, and cozy. It’s one of those cute little spots that photograph really well and give off good vibes.

We ordered a few things to try:
🍜 Japanese Ramen Bowl (₹520) – The quantity was generous, and the flavours were quite nice. It’s a comforting bowl and filling enough for one person.
🍳 Shakshouka (₹400) – This one was surprisingly good! The taste was on point, and the portion size was enough for two people to share.
🥤 Blueberry Spirulina Smoothie (₹400) – Sadly, this was the only miss for us. It mostly tasted like banana with barely any blueberry flavour, so it didn’t feel worth the price.

The service was quite slow — it took about 35–40 minutes for our food to arrive, even though the café wasn’t crowded when we visited.

Overall, I’d give 3/5 stars. The pricing is definitely on the higher side, and while the food was decent, it’s not something I’d crave to go back for (except maybe to try their smoothie bowls next time!).

featured_reviews.review_text:
Bombay Salad Co., Bandra – Healthy, Hearty & Actually Delicious 🥗☕

Sip • Grab • Taste

Visited Bombay Salad Co. on a Saturday with family, and this place genuinely delivers on the healthy-but-still-tasty promise. The menu is built for health-conscious eaters, but even someone who isn’t into salads will find plenty to enjoy here.

📍 Location & Access
It’s located just off Linking Road, but the approach lane is quite narrow. Valet parking is not available, so if you’re driving, it’s smarter to park a little ahead and walk. Avoid taking the car right to the door not worth the stress.

🍴 What We Ordered:

Three Salad Bowls – we chose the small bowls, but the portions were still surprisingly generous. Fresh greens, good balance of protein and crunch, and well-made dressings nothing watery or bland here.

Cappuccino – smooth, well-made, not bitter. A nice warm pairing with fresh salads.

✨ Ambience & Experience
The vibe is calm, cozy, and “feel good” without trying too hard. Staff is polite, service is steady, and the ingredients felt fresh  which is the real win for a salad-focused place.

⭐ Overall Verdict:
If you're looking for healthy food that doesn't taste like a compromise, Bombay Salad Co. hits the mark.
Great for a relaxed meal, post-gym brunch, or a weekend family catch-up.

Another one for the foodie trail – SGT Reviews ✍️

Stopped by Sequel in Bandra looking for a break from the intense spices I've been having on my trip to Mumbai, and it definitely delivered on that front. The ambiance is 10/10—super clean, very aesthetic, and a great place to hang out. The service was also top-notch; the staff is really attentive. Unfortunately when I visited, the wifi wasn't working, so I wasn't able to work there like I planned.

I ordered the Fold Over Omelette and the Super Green Smoothie. Both hit the spot for a lighter, "clean" meal. My only critique is that I wish the flavors were a bit more developed! Compared to healthy food spots I’ve frequented in the States, the taste felt a little flat. I also would love to see some higher-protein additions with chicken on the menu.

Overall, a solid choice if you want something healthy and light in a beautiful setting!

The ingredients are consistently clean, organic, and clearly well sourced… you can taste the care that goes into every dish. It’s the kind of place where you don’t have to second-guess what you’re eating, which matters to me as a aromatherapist and nutritionist.

The menu always feels nourishing rather than restrictive, and I love that I can eat here regularly and still feel light and energised.

On top of that, the service is always great. Genuinely welcoming without being in your face. It’s one of those places that gets both food and experience right, every single time.

If you’re looking for real, honest, feel-good food in Bandra, Sequel is a standout.

Some restaurants impress with extravagance; others win you over with comfort, consistency, and food that simply hits the right notes. Bayleaf Cafe, Juhu, falls into the latter category.

From the moment we walked in, the warm ambience set the tone for a relaxed and enjoyable meal. The space strikes a nice balance between casual and inviting, making it ideal for an easy lunch, a coffee catch-up, or a leisurely dinner.

While everything we tried was enjoyable, the undisputed star of the table was the Pink Sauce Pasta. Rich, creamy, and beautifully balanced, it brought together the tanginess of tomato and the smoothness of a cream sauce in perfect harmony. Comfort food at its finest, and easily a dish worth returning for.

Good food, a pleasant atmosphere, and an experience that leaves you satisfied rather than rushed—Bayleaf Cafe delivered on all fronts. If you're in Juhu and looking for a relaxed dining spot, this cafe is well worth a visit. And whatever you order, don't leave without trying the Pink Sauce Pasta.
